claim: The wrong-joint tell is measurable: blind-judge lift <= 0 on >= 1 usable pair names the joint as greeter-territory, and the route is greeter-first through an authored lexicon — zero model calls, hostile backends included.
evidence: the 71-c corpus replay, receipted in quilt-storefront 37ff181: corpus A 12 greeter moments, lift -0.25 (model 8.0 vs authored table 8.25), 4 usable pairs, 8 receipted unpaired; corpus B 6 fact controls, lift +1/6 REFUSED — the rule discriminates the joints, so the zero-call wiring is measurement, not thrift theater
why: a joint where the model adds nothing is not a smaller-model problem but a NO-MODEL problem: the table IS the competence, and the blind lift is the instrument that proves it — spent joints and greeter joints must be sorted before any seat is billed

pins.name: greeter-territory generalizes beyond warmth
pins.how: the rule’s shape (outcome-free + blind lift <= 0) names a class of joints; n=1 domain so far — generalization condition: a second soft-joint domain scored by the same blind-lift protocol with a refused control corpus
